 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER

begin
 update private.dic_member_approval_poll_gate set last_polled_at=now()
 where singleton=true and last_polled_at < now()-interval '4 minutes';
 return found;
end $function$
